summary: Netflix filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1 billion offering of 5.250% senior notes due 2036, priced at 99.255% of par. The notes pay semi-annual interest starting Feb 2027, are redeemable early, and will settle on T+2 via DTC/Clearstream/Euroclear. Joint book-runners include BNP Paribas, Morgan Stanley, RBC, and Wells Fargo. Proceeds net of underwriting discount are ~$988.6M, intended for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation features are present; the filing is a standard takedown from Netflix's shelf registration.
